description: Manifest of available AI API key SOPS entries. Generated by apply scripts from the decrypted system.yml; consumed by litellm-config.nix and sops.nix at Nix evaluation time.

availableKeys.description: List of SOPS key names that exist (non-null) in system.yml. Each entry matches the pattern ai_*_api_key or ai_*_api_key_N.
